content.text: is the ci capable of building both frontend and backend at once
I’ll check the CI workflows to see how the frontend and backend builds are configured.

input.input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"rg --files --hidden .github && cat .github/workflows/*","max_output_tokens":9000}));text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat docker/Dockerfile docker/Dockerfile.frontend frontend/package.json","max_output_tokens":4000}));

content.text:
Yes, CI builds both in the same workflow run, but **sequentially**, not simultaneously.

The [shared build action](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/.github/actions/build-images/action.yml:52) builds the backend first, then the frontend, followed by migration and CLI images.

This runs on pushes to `main` or manual dispatch. Pull-request CI currently runs only Rust Clippy checks; it doesn't build the frontend.

To build frontend and backend simultaneously, they would need separate parallel jobs or a Docker Bake build.
